text:
Automated password recovery is seamless—until it isn't. If you lose access to both your primary email and your phone number, standard workflows hit a dead end, leaving you permanently locked out. 

This is where a manual fallback becomes essential. By incorporating human review or formal identity verification, companies can bridge the gap that algorithms cannot. For high-stakes accounts, manual intervention serves as a vital safety net, ensuring that security doesn't come at the cost of total accessibility. Don't let an automated loop become a digital dead end.
